title: PPL supply and launch plan
lead: How the fixed one-billion PPL supply is allocated, unlocked and sold before and after mainnet. Numbers are preliminary and subject to community governance.
banner: Preliminary — subject to community governance vote.
supplyBody: Total supply is fixed at 1,000,000,000 PPL (one billion). In years 1–4 there is 0% inflation — no new coins beyond the unlock schedules below. From year 5, any additional emission is capped at 2% per year and only by community vote.
testnetNote: The internal testnet used a 1M PPL premine for experiments. That balance does not carry over — mainnet accounting starts from zero.
allocationLead: Six buckets at launch. Tap or hover a slice to see its share, size and unlock path.

bucketNotes.community: 35% genesis bucket — founders, bounties, ambassadors, airdrops and onboarding rewards only from this pool (released over 6 years).
bucketNotes.validators: 200M PPL (20%): years 1–4 pay 6%, 5%, 5%, 4% of total supply per year (60M / 50M / 50M / 40M), plus 30% of network fees.
bucketNotes.team: 15% of supply: 0% at launch, 6-month cliff, then 18 months of linear monthly unlocks (24 months total).
bucketNotes.treasury: Spent only after DAO votes; held in multisig.
bucketNotes.sale: 25% at genesis on People, remainder monthly over 9 months.
bucketNotes.liquidity: PPL/USDT pool at sale close; LP tokens locked 2+ years.

circulatingLead: Estimated liquid PPL in circulation by month (0–120). DAO treasury stays off-chart until voted; LP allocation counts after the 2-year lock.
saleLead: Up to 100M PPL from the sale bucket (10% of the fixed supply) are sold on a public exponential curve. Published parameters match the live /buy page and the order API.
salePayBody: Pay with USDC or USDT from Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base, TON, Tron or Solana. One curve, one price — whatever network you pay from. Sell payouts default to USDC on Base unless you choose another chain.
saleDeliveryBody: Native PPL is credited to the same 0x address on the People network at genesis, following the vesting schedule above.
curveLead: Exponential curve: price starts at $0.005 per PPL and rises with every purchase, up to a $0.25 ceiling while the curve is open. Graduation closes the curve at $4M raised.
unsoldBody: The sale runs until all PPL is sold or for 24 months, whichever comes first. The term is fixed and will not be extended. After it ends, whatever was raised is split 50/50 between locked LP and the project multisig, and any unsold PPL on the curve goes to the community pool; there are no refunds. Until then, unsold PPL is held in the project multisig and the team does not touch it. Token curves on PEOPLE keep their own 180-day finalize rule for unsold tokens.
feeLead: Every protocol fee on People follows the approved Model A routing:
feeNote: Every protocol fee is split: 30% to validators, 25% to the community pool, 20% to the treasury, 10% to liquidity, 15% to Growth, 0% burned — including fractional fees.
buybackBody: 100% of token and NFT launch fees (USDC/USDT) go to public PPL buybacks. The StableFeeGateway contract is implemented and deployed on the testnet: every stablecoin launch fee goes to the public buyback recipient. 30% of network fees go to public PPL buybacks (treasury 20% + liquidity 10%). The remaining 70% of network fees go to validators (30%), the community pool (25%) and the Growth Pool (15%) — and it all ultimately goes back to participants. Bought-back PPL is then split 30/25/20/10/15 by the 2-of-3 treasury multisig — that split is a published multisig policy, not a rule enforced on-chain.
contractsLead: On-chain addresses are published when mainnet launches — not placeholders on this page.

contractRows.name: Sale contracts (BNB Chain, Base, Ethereum, Polygon, Tron, TON, Solana)

legendHint: Click a legend item to focus a slice.
emissionLead: Security rewards come from the pre-allocated validator pool and network fees — not from minting new supply in years 1–4.
emissionBullets: Years 1–4: 0% inflation — the one-billion cap is not increased.
Validator pool: 200M PPL unlocked on a 6% / 5% / 5% / 4% of total supply schedule (60M, 50M, 50M, 40M PPL in years 1–4), plus 30% of every protocol fee.
Founders, bounties, ambassadors and airdrops are funded only from the 35% community & rewards bucket.
From year 5 onward, new emission is at most 2% per year and requires a community governance vote.
launchOrderBody: Founders airdrop runs first. The community PPL sale opens only after 1,000 verified people are registered and sale proceeds are secured by a published multisig.
salePublicBody: Prices, limits and the curve formula are public on /buy. Purchases stay disabled until the sale hub contract is deployed; connecting a wallet does not commit you to anything.
saleCurveBullets: 100,000,000 PPL on the curve (10% of supply); start $0.005, exponential rise, $0.25 cap on the curve only.
Graduation at $4,000,000 raised. Sale runs until all PPL is sold or 24 months (fixed term); then unsold PPL to the community pool.
Raise split 50% locked liquidity / 50% project multisig; LP tokens locked 24 months.
Sell-back allowed with a 1.5% fee to PPL buyback. Limits: $500 per buy, $2,000 per person per day, 60s cooldown.
